テキスト cha 441: Born around Shiyo 783. Height 165cm. Transferred to Motoki High School on April 13, Shiyo 800. She is the image of Ito, and Natsumi Kogori wonders if Ito was reborn and came to Motoki-cho. She has no memories from before April 8; her real age and past are unknown. She lives in a Motoki-cho care facility. Told by Natsumi she resembles Ito, she says, "Then that's fine. Right now I'm nobody," and seems not to deny being Ito's reincarnation.
